## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in Awesome Biomolecular Design.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Add a new tool, database, model, API, or workflow
- [ ] Update an existing entry
- [ ] Fix broken or outdated information
- [ ] Improve documentation or repository maintenance

## Contribution Criteria

For new or updated tool entries, confirm:

- [ ] The resource fits a biomolecular design modality or pipeline stage covered by this repository.
- [ ] The description is factual, concise, and not promotional.
- [ ] A stable URL, repository, publication, or documentation link is included.
- [ ] Install or access instructions are included when available.
- [ ] A minimal usage example is included when practical.
- [ ] The entry is placed in the most specific matching section.
- [ ] Existing entries were checked to avoid duplicates.

## Validation

- [ ] I checked all new or changed links.
- [ ] I checked Markdown formatting in the changed section.
- [ ] I kept unrelated changes out of this pull request.

## Notes for Reviewers

Mention any uncertainty, such as unclear maintenance status, missing publication details, restricted access, or section placement tradeoffs.
